versions.subject: Renamed rule files, new rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    - EventLog: Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational
      EventID: 1
      ParentImage:
        - '*\apache*'
        - '*\tomcat*'
      CommandLine: 
        - 'whoami'
        - 'net user'
        - 'ping -n'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventLog="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventID=1 ParentImage IN ("*\\apache*", "*\\tomcat*") CommandLine IN ("whoami", "net user", "ping -n")
